methods.transfer: Compressed response-body bytes served by the actual harness on successful GETs, with headers and external requests excluded. The production figure re-encodes the same requested resources without the observation hooks, using gzip level 6 for text.
methods.timing: Intervals between main-scene render returns and independent browser animation-frame callbacks. Chrome mobile emulation uses the laptop GPU.
